text:
tom.newhire: Hey team — first day! Quick q on secrets: I need DB creds for staging and a service account for S3. Who do I ask and what's the proper process for Vault/KMS access? Also any rotation/how often I should expect creds to change? Thanks!

alex.m: Welcome Tom! :tada: For secrets we use Vault + our KMS. Please open a request in the Secrets Portal: https://vault.internal.redwood/secrets-request. Include environment, resource path(s), purpose, and suggested approvers. If you need immediate access, DM me and I can grant a temporary token for 24h. Example request snippet:
```
{
  "env": "staging",
  "resource": "kv/data/apps/my-service",
  "purpose": "migrate staging DB access",
  "approvers": ["eng-platform"]
}
```

sara.security: FYI permanent secrets require 2 approvers (infra + security). Rotation policy: production DB creds rotate every 30 days, staging/dev 90 days. Service account keys should be short-lived via our token service — avoid long-lived static keys.

tom.newhire: Thanks — how do I pick an approver? I don't yet know who owns infra.

alex.m: In the form there's a "suggested approvers" field. Put the owning team name (eg "eng-platform") and I'll add @maria.platform as the default reviewer. Here's the playbook: https://wiki.redwood/secrets-playbook

maria.platform: _(added)_ Happy to review staging access. Please include the runbook / minimal permissions path and I'll approve once that's clear.

devex-bot: Secrets Portal — ticket #SEC-1245 created by tom.newhire. Status: pending_approvals. Link: https://vault.internal.redwood/tickets/SEC-1245

tom.newhire: One more Q: if my app uses Vault dynamic creds, do I need to rotate anything manually or is it automatic?

sara.security: Dynamic creds rotate automatically according to the TTL on the role. Make sure your app renews before expiry or uses short TTL with token renewal. If you want, we can pair to set the role and TTL.

alex.m: I'll DM you the temp token and a quick setup checklist (env var names, example Vault policy). Ping me if anything blocks — welcome aboard! :wave:
